title: Find exact hardware RT enablement path for Linux SPEAR package
objective: Determine the concrete repository changes needed to make hardware ray tracing actually active for the user's cafeteria live run. The latest user log shows Unreal starts with Platform=VULKAN_SM5 and 'Ray tracing is disabled. Reason: not supported by current RHI.' Investigate UE 5.5/SPEAR local config and official Unreal guidance for Linux Vulkan hardware RT, Vulkan SM6 targeted shader formats, required project settings/CVars/RHI flags, cook/package implications, and whether an alternate RHI is viable on this machine. Inspect local project config, run/cook scripts, and relevant UE target/platform config files. Return a Builder-ready plan with exact files/settings/commands, including how to verify logs should change away from VULKAN_SM5 and confirm hardware RT. Do not edit files.
expected_outputs: Exact implementation plan for real hardware RT enablement, not just crash avoidance.
definition_of_done: Plan identifies why current package is VULKAN_SM5, exact config/build changes to get SM6/HWRT if supported, and validation commands/log signatures.
